1.$description: Categorical series 1 of 4, always used first; also the highlight in highlight-on-grey charts.

4.$description: Categorical series 4 of 4; context bars in highlight-on-grey charts.

rest.$description: Remainder or empty fill, never a categorical series; too close to series 4 under colour-vision deficiency, so draw it with a series 4 outline.

axis.$description: Axis lines and ticks (non-text, Owner ruling 1, 2026-10-09); axis labels use tertiary.
